beats.headline: AMD rises 7.25% on above-average volume

beats.headline: AMD declines 3.79% as peers gain

beats.headline: AMD adds 5.16% as customer and competitor fall

beats.headline: AMD rises 4.02% following 8-K filing

beats.headline: AMD surges 18.61% after 10-Q filing
beats.explanation: AMD surged 18.61% to $421.39 on 4.3 times average volume following its quarterly 10-Q filing and prior-day 8-K. The broad semiconductor move was shared with industry partners, as competitor NVDA rose 5.77% and supplier TSM climbed 6.36%. Customer MSFT also added 0.63%.

beats.headline: AMD climbs 11.44% in post-earnings momentum
beats.explanation: AMD increased 11.44% to $455.19 on 2.8 times average volume in continued trading following its May 6 Form 10-Q filing. The move was company-specific, as competitor NVDA rose a modest 1.75%, supplier TSM dipped 0.60%, and customer MSFT fell 1.34%.

beats.headline: AMD tops $500 with a 7.78% advance

beats.headline: AMD drops 8.15% in company-specific pullback
beats.explanation: AMD declined 8.15% to $454.62 on 1.8 times its 30-day average volume. No company news was reported to explain the drop. While supplier TSM declined 1.70%, the retreat was largely company-specific as competitor NVDA edged up 0.25% and customer MSFT rose 1.09%.

beats.headline: AMD declines 7.04% after filing 10-Q and 8-K
beats.explanation: AMD shares dropped 7.04% to $482.05 on 2.4 times typical volume on the day it filed a quarterly Form 10-Q, following an 8-K filing on August 4. The decline was company-specific, as competitor NVDA climbed 3.44%, supplier TSM dipped 0.76%, and customer MSFT declined 1.09%.

beats.headline: AMD jumps 9.95% to top $1 trillion valuation
beats.explanation: AMD advanced 9.95% to $615.52 on 2.2 times normal volume as reports showed it crossed $1 trillion in market cap and expanded deployments of its Instinct MI325X GPUs for AI workloads. The gain was shared across the sector, with competitor NVDA rising 2.30%, supplier TSM advancing 2.41%, and customer MSFT up 1.59%.

arc: AMD experienced substantial appreciation between March and September 2026, climbing from $205.37 to $615.52. The stock's dramatic trajectory was shaped by major company milestones, starting with an 18.61% single-day surge in May following its quarterly 10-Q filing. Although the stock encountered sharp company-specific pullbacks in late July and after its August 10-Q filing, momentum returned strongly by late September when AMD crossed the $1 trillion market capitalization milestone on expanded Instinct MI325X GPU adoption. Investors should note that while several significant moves were company-specific, AMD's largest upward days frequently aligned with shared rallies alongside supplier TSM and competitor NVDA.
